She hinges at her waist, lowering the weights toward her shins while keeping her back flat. Her form is steady as she looks toward the floor. A male gym member is visible walking in the background. (5) The final phase shows her sitting on the gym floor, leaning back on one hand. She appears exhausted but satisfied, exhaling after her workout. The background shows other people working out on various machines in a well-lit, spacious fitness center.
